Exclusive Pirate-Themed Supporter Decorations: Supporter Companion riding in its own tiny pirate boat Pirate-style Steering Wheel Skull Figurehead Cabin proudly flying a pirate flag Completely unnecessary, entirely cosmetic, and not guaranteed to make your Wanderburg seaworthy. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Supporter Pack is a way for fans who want to go the extra mile to directly contribute to Wanderburg's ongoing development. This cosmetic-only DLC does not give you any gameplay advantages — it just gives your castle a distinctly pirate-shaped dose of extra flair and comes with the official Wanderburg soundtrack!

The Supporter Pack includes:

  • The Official Wanderburg Soundtrack - made by Tumult Kollektiv!

  • Exclusive Pirate-Themed Supporter Decorations:

    • Supporter Companion riding in its own tiny pirate boat

    • Pirate-style Steering Wheel

    • Skull Figurehead

    • Cabin proudly flying a pirate flag

Completely unnecessary, entirely cosmetic, and not guaranteed to make your Wanderburg seaworthy.

Your purchase of the Supporter Pack helps us continue adding new content and features to the game. So thanks for joining the crew.
